chunks: If one does not have the means (of doing so) then he should fast for two months continuously before he has physical contact; but any one who is unable to do so, should feed sixty needy persons.
This (is enjoined) so that you may be faithful to God and His Apostle. These are the limits set by God. As for the unbelievers, there is painful punishment for them.
ai.seo_question: What is the hierarchy of expiation for breaking the fast in Ramadan due to intercourse?
ai.summary: This passage details the hierarchical expiation (kaffarah) for unintentional sexual intercourse during Ramadan, prioritizing fasting for two consecutive months, then feeding sixty poor people, and finally freeing a slave if capable. Shia scholars emphasize the strict continuity (mutatabi'an) of the fasting days and the specific calculation of a mudd of staple food per poor person. The text concludes by linking these practical duties to faith in God and His Messenger, establishing them as divine limits (hudud) for believers.
